name: Klamath Basin Forests and Watersheds Restoration
summary: Request for proposals from NFWF and USDA NRCS for forest, watershed and fish and wildlife habitat restoration and monitoring across the Klamath Basin in Oregon and California.

amount.note: Shasta Valley RCPP track; the Upper Klamath Watershed Resilience track has a $100,000-$500,000 range

deadline.text: May 18, 2026, by 8:59 PM PT/11:59 PM ET

status.quote: Klamath Basin Forests and Watersheds Restoration 2026 Request For Proposals - CLOSED

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date May 18, 2026, by 8:59 PM PT/11:59 PM ET

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include: non-profit 501(c) organizations, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal governments and organizations, special districts (e.g., conservation districts, planning districts, utility districts), and educational institutions.

geography.quote: fish and wildlife conservation, restoration, and monitoring projects across the Klamath Basin

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

co_finance_required.quote: Matching funds or partner contribution are required and will be a factor in proposal evaluation.
